parameters.description:
Send an email to your own SMTP2Go destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-smtp2go-email` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). On the Apprise channels the gateway composes an Apprise `smtp2go://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters; the `gateway` and `gateway-plus` channels skip Apprise, transform the envelope into a native SMTP2GO v3 email/send payload, and deliver it straight to api.smtp2go.com. The `gateway` channel is free, while `gateway-plus` is $0.001 per message for extra per-enrollment SMTP2GO destinations.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment SMTP2GO destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to SMTP2GO v3 email/send (no Apprise)
